description: Validates JSON data against a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12): valid true or false, and up to 50 errors with the instance path, the keyword and the message. Schema and data are each limited to 200 KB. Remote $ref targets are not fetched. No network call. Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
